description: Kinetic caption for fast commentary edits: 1-4 big rounded words on a flat charcoal background, cut exactly on the spoken word. Put a picture inside the sentence with [img], or write the caption over a meme/photo with bg.

fields.text: 1-4 words. *word* = highlight color, \n = new line, [img] = the img picture inside the sentence
fields.img: Picture shown where [img] is in the text (logo, face, emoji image). Square-ish works best
fields.bg: Optional full-frame background picture (meme, photo). The caption sits at the top over it, like a meme caption
fields.position: center (default) or top. bg captions default to top
fields.color: Highlight color for *words* (hex, default brand accent)
fields.size: Text size in px (default 150; long text shrinks to fit)
fields.background: Background color when there's no bg (default #1e1e1e charcoal)
